slides.title: things to **delete** before you paste anything into AI.
slides.sub: A quick check that keeps customer and staff data out of your chats.
slides.tag: Plus the safe way to paste ↓

slides.title: An AI chat is not your **private notebook**.
paras: Depending on your plan and settings, what you paste can be stored, and sometimes reviewed to improve the tool.
So check your assistant's data settings once. Then build one habit: strip private details before you paste.

steps.d: Full card, account and routing numbers. Write "the customer's card" instead.
Including one-time codes and shared team logins. AI never needs them.
Names with emails, phones or home addresses. Use [CUSTOMER].
Yours, your staff's or your customers'. Describe the situation, not the person.
Pay, reviews, Social Security or ID numbers. Use [EMPLOYEE] and leave numbers out.
Anything under an NDA or a client contract. If you promised to keep it private, keep it out.

slides.title: Use a **placeholder** instead
slides.note: AI doesn't need the real details to write a good reply.

before.label: RISKY PASTE
before.text: Write a refund reply to Sarah Jenkins, sarah@example.com, 14 Oak Lane. Card ending 4421, order 88123. Her tile arrived cracked.

after.label: SAFE PASTE
after.text: Write a short, warm refund reply to [CUSTOMER]. Order [ORDER]: a tile arrived cracked. We'll refund in full or send a replacement, their choice. Keep [CUSTOMER] and [ORDER] as placeholders.

slides.note: Example customer and tile shop, invented.

messages.text:
Hi [CUSTOMER],
I'm so sorry your tile arrived cracked. That's not how we wanted your project to start.
We can refund order [ORDER] in full or send a replacement, whichever you prefer. Just reply and let us know.
Thanks for your patience,
[YOUR NAME]

slides.note: Fill in the real name in your email app, not in the chat.

slides.title: The **before-you-paste** check
items: Card, bank or login details? Delete.
Health or staff records? Leave them out.
Under an NDA? Don't paste it.
Check your tool's data settings once.

caption:
What not to paste into an AI chat: 6 privacy rules for small business owners

AI chat assistants are great for drafting replies. But depending on your plan and settings, what you paste may be stored or reviewed.

Never paste:
1) Card and bank numbers
2) Passwords and login codes
3) Customer names with contact details
4) Health information
5) Staff records (pay, reviews, ID numbers)
6) Anything under an NDA or client contract

Swap details for placeholders instead. The safe version I tested:

"Write a short, warm refund reply to [CUSTOMER]. Order [ORDER]: a tile arrived cracked. We'll refund in full or send a replacement, their choice. Keep [CUSTOMER] and [ORDER] as placeholders."

The reply was just as good. You add the real name in your email app.
